boards.school_name: The University of Texas at Austin
boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UT Libraries spaces for quiet work, collaborative sessions, writing support, and creative projects across the Forty Acres.

cards.title: PCL Quiet Stacks Seating
cards.subtitle: Perry-Castañeda Library · Floors 3, 4, and 6
cards.notes: Choose a table in the stacks when you need quiet individual work; bring a device, use the outlets, and keep conversation elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: Open stack seating for focused solo study.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries identifies these open tables in PCL’s stacks as quiet, individual study seating on floors 3, 4, and 6, available to the public.
cards.source_title: PCL Quiet Stacks Seating | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Non-reservable; listed as public access. Check current PCL building hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: The Hall of Noble Words Reading Room
cards.title: The Hall of Noble Words Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Life Science Library · Main Building, Room 2.227
cards.notes: Use the west-end reading room for a quiet session with natural light; select a large or small table and observe the quiet designation.
cards.short_summary: A large historic reading room with quiet-study seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries describes the Hall of Noble Words as an all-access, quiet-study room with natural light, tables, and abundant seating.
cards.source_title: The Hall of Noble Words Reading Room | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Non-reservable and listed as public access; located on the second floor of the Life Science Library.

cards.title: Stacks Seating at Life Science Library
cards.subtitle: Life Science Library · Floors 4, 5, and 6
cards.notes: Head to the upper stacks for an individual quiet-work table; Wi-Fi is listed, so it suits reading, drafting, or laptop tasks.
cards.short_summary: Quiet individual tables distributed through the Life Science stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries lists 84 seats of small-table, individual quiet-study seating on floors 4 through 6 of the Life Science Library.
cards.source_title: Stacks Seating (LSL) | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Non-reservable and listed as public access. UT ID is required for Life Science Library evenings and weekends.

cards.title: Fine Arts Stacks Seating
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Library · Fifth Floor
cards.notes: Settle at a fifth-floor table for quiet individual work and natural light; use it as a reading stop while browsing the Fine Arts collections.
cards.short_summary: Public quiet-study tables on the Fine Arts Library’s fifth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries describes Fine Arts Stacks Seating as open study tables for quiet individual study, with natural light and a listed capacity of 160.
cards.source_title: Fine Arts Stacks Seating | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Non-reservable and listed as public access; the Fine Arts Library is in Doty Fine Arts Building.

cards.title: Fine Arts Library Carrels
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Library · Fifth Floor
cards.notes: Graduate students can ask the library desk about a semester carrel or shelf; plan for a quiet, single-person workspace rather than a drop-in table.
cards.short_summary: Semester-based individual workspaces for UT graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries says Fine Arts Library carrels are reservable desks and shelves on level 5, with graduate-student access and semester-based checkout.
cards.source_title: Fine Arts Library Carrels | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: For UT graduate students; request a carrel or shelf at the Fine Arts Library desk.

cards.title: The Foundry at Fine Arts Library
cards.subtitle: Fine Arts Library · Doty Fine Arts Building, third floor
cards.notes: Bring a creative project and ask about the needed training before using specialized equipment; the space also includes recording and presentation facilities.
cards.short_summary: A campus makerspace for fabrication, media, and creative production.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries states that the Foundry provides university students, faculty, and staff tools and space for creative projects, including 3D printers, laser cutting, sewing, and recording.
cards.source_title: The Foundry | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open to university students, faculty, and staff; some equipment requires certification and availability should be confirmed with the library.

cards.title: Graduate Landing Spot
cards.subtitle: Perry-Castañeda Library · Scholars Commons, Room 2.430
cards.notes: Graduate students can use the lounge for quiet work or reserve a media-equipped room for a small group session; bring UT ID for entry.
cards.short_summary: Graduate-only lounge and meeting-room area within Scholars Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries identifies the Graduate Landing Spot as a UT-ID-accessible area with lounge space, a kitchenette, and reservable meeting rooms for graduate-student study and meetings.
cards.source_title: Graduate Landing Spot | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Restricted to UT graduate students and accessible by UT ID; Scholars Commons rooms are reservable by eligible graduate students.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Perry-Castañeda Library · Entry level, second floor
cards.notes: Use this hub to combine collaborative study with research or writing help; check whether a Learning Lab is free of scheduled classes first.
cards.short_summary: A PCL academic-support hub with collaborative-study options.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries says the Learning Commons offers research and writing help, media software, workshops, and collaborative study; its Learning Labs serve as study spaces outside scheduled classes.
cards.source_title: Learning Commons | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on PCL’s second floor. Learning Labs are study spaces when not scheduled as classrooms; check current renovation and building notices.

cards.title: UFCU Room
cards.subtitle: Perry-Castañeda Library · Entry level, second floor
cards.notes: Use the room for studying when no event is scheduled, then browse the adjacent Poetry Center collection for a reading break or research lead.
cards.short_summary: A study room that also houses UT’s Poetry Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries states that the UFCU Room, including the UT Poetry Center, is normally available as study space and is occasionally used for events.
cards.source_title: UFCU Room | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Normally a study space but may be used for events; consult the room’s current schedule or use policy.

cards.title: Scholars Lab Open Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Perry-Castañeda Library · Second floor, Room 2.200
cards.notes: Use a whiteboard, display, or outlet-equipped table for conversation-friendly project work; no reservation is needed for the open-study area.
cards.short_summary: Drop-in collaborative study tables in the Scholars Lab.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Libraries identifies the Scholars Lab open study spaces as reservation-free, public-access seating with whiteboards, external displays, and outlets.
cards.source_title: Scholars Lab Open Study Spaces | University of Texas Libraries
cards.access_notes: Non-reservable and listed as public access; the space is conversation-friendly rather than designated quiet.
